text:
alex: Heads-up: user-facing hallucinations spiked after the recent runtime change in us-west1. Proposing an expedited hotfix deploy with greypass to reduce customer impact.

ops-oncall: Need blast radius and rollback plan before we greenlight.

alex: Blast radius: us-west1 text-gen pool (~8% of traffic). Rollback plan: revert image to `prod-2026-03-18-a7c9` and pin model back to `rk-v2-stable`. Rollback via `deploybot rollback --id DB-61950`.

maria: I'll run a 3-node smoke and a small synthetic prompt suite (20 prompts). Starting now.

deploybot: deploybot: Initiating expedited workflow. Request ID DB-61950. Greypass requested. Automated checks: artifact-signature OK, infra health OK, e2e pending. React :white_check_mark: to approve or type `veto` to block.

jason: Infra validated signatures & drain scripts. Conditional +1 after smoke passes.

maria: Smoke started (18:12). Initial run 18/20 - failing were token-boundary cases; pushed rebuild `hotfix-9f7`, re-running ETA ~2m.

alex: Confirmed: no DB/schema changes. Post-deploy watch keys: `textgen.hallucination_rate`, `textgen.errors.rate`, `textgen.latency.p99`. Will pin model `rk-v2-hotfix-04` during rollout.

maria: Smoke now 20/20 on 3 nodes. No infra regressions observed.

deploybot: deploybot: e2e checks passed 12/12. Approvals recorded: jason, ops-oncall, release-council. Proceeding to deploy to us-west1: `deploybot deploy --id DB-61950 --image hotfix-9f7 --pin-model rk-v2-hotfix-04 --region us-west1 --greypass`.

deploybot: deploybot: Step 1 -> 50% traffic switch live. Monitor: https://dash.internal/rollouts/DB-61950

ops-oncall: Dashboards live. Alerts set: hallucination_rate > 1.5%, errors > 0.5%, p99 latency > baseline+30ms.

deploybot: deploybot: Step 2 -> 100% traffic switch complete. Deployment succeeded. All automated checks green.

alex: Post-deploy metrics: hallucination_rate down to 0.3%, errors 0.09%, latency stable. Closing expedited hotfix. I'll write a short postmortem tomorrow with root cause (quant-token mismatch) and mitigation.

release-council: I'll publish the release note including the tokenizer change and rollback steps once you drop the postmortem link.

maria: Kicking off cross-region canary tests for the quant path; will report any anomalies overnight.
